'''Borelord''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cragolin]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Borelord is the self-proclaimed master planner of camp. All buildings must be placed according to the grand design!"

Borelord is a red rarity Tatari.

== Trivia ==
